subject.character: ONE garden snail, grey-olive body, clear face, eyes on long stalks, small mouth; brown shell with a heavy brass padlock, chain along the step off past the camera; same face and colour throughout
subject.physicality: snaps stalks in, skates on wet stone leaving a glinting slime trail
subject.anti_action: weary serious face, brisk dry talker

second_characters: ONE magpie; ONE small shell-less hermit crab, smaller than the shell
props: padlock: smooth brass, no engraving; disc: smooth gold, no engraving
environment: wet stone garden step after rain; dense background: wet leaves, moss, drops, clay pots
lighting: low sun behind-left through stalks, sky glow behind-right, glints on brass and gold, high contrast, bright
motion_rule: Camera orbits him every beat; leaves, pots, moss slide behind him. Shot size changes every beat as he nears or leaves the camera. He skates, skids or turns every beat. Magpie and crab work big in the foreground.

audio.delivery: flat low brisk male voice, native, no accent; first word on frame one; stress VYgodny
audio.pacing: each line once inside its beat, nothing said after 6.3

timeline.a: mouth opens on every syllable; his stalks snap in and shoot back out, body arched, as a magpie wing lashes across the foreground; camera orbits left to right
mouth opens on every syllable; camera arcs right to left; he stretches tall to the magpie, which lands big on the step edge at the lens and drops a gold disc
mouth opens on every syllable; he skates onto the disc, skids sideways; it sticks to his sole; camera orbits after the skid
he slides to the lower step, disc on his sole, shell bouncing, as the chain jerks taut along the step past the camera; camera orbits after him
mouth opens on every syllable; he whips round to the crab, stalks snap in, as a hermit crab, big in the foreground, seizes the chain and pulls; camera orbits round to his face
mouth opens on every syllable; he rears back, braces, skids in a half circle, as the crab hauls the chain claw over claw; camera arcs around the pair
mouth opens on every syllable; he rears up, bends both stalks onto his own chest, as the crab climbs his shell and clasps the padlock; low orbit
he slips out bare, unharmed, sliding forward, sun flashing on his wet body, as the crab lifts the shell off by the padlock; camera orbits after him
he turns, body in a wave, as the crab backs into the shell big at his side, padlock clicks; camera arcs behind him
he lunges after the shell, skids half a turn, as the crab scuttles the shell off sideways, chain whipping past the camera; camera orbits against the skid
he spins round as the magpie sweeps across the foreground and plucks the disc off his sole; camera arcs low under the magpie
he skates across the wet step, skids broadside past the camera, stalks whipping, face big in frame; behind, a claw waves from the locked shell; camera orbits

must_appear: 0.00 padlock and chain on shell; 0.80 magpie drops gold disc; 6.30 crab lifts shell off by padlock; 7.05 crab in shell; final: bare snail skids broadside, face big; crab claw waves from locked shell
